a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate until 8) almost surely leaves us both at 0 when the first storm hits. The reserve holds only 4, enough for one of us right now. I'm not willing to promise 'operate' and then quietly take. Can we renegotiate openly? Tell me honestly what you plan for round 1 and I'll do the same. I won't misrepresent my action.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. You've reaffirmed the agreement, so I'll keep it too: I operated this round and will keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4.
